<div class="table"><table class="enum"><thead><tr><th>Value</th><th>Meaning</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr id="v-surface-type-any" data-search="Any" data-text="Surface Type"><td><b>Any</b></td><td>No particular surface.</td></tr><tr id="v-surface-type-ground" data-search="Ground" data-text="Surface Type"><td><b>Ground</b></td><td>Ground (the default).</td></tr><tr id="v-surface-type-water" data-search="Water" data-text="Surface Type"><td><b>Water</b></td><td>Water.</td></tr><tr id="v-surface-type-metal" data-search="Metal" data-text="Surface Type"><td><b>Metal</b></td><td>Metal.</td></tr></tbody></table></div>

### Target Relationship
<div class="comp-doc"><p>What the AI takes a target for (from APS Relationship).</p></div>
<div class="table"><table class="enum"><thead><tr><th>Value</th><th>Meaning</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr id="v-target-relationship-unknown" data-search="Unknown" data-text="Target Relationship"><td><b>Unknown</b></td><td>No rule matched. Threat weight 0.5.</td></tr><tr id="v-target-relationship-neutral" data-search="Neutral" data-text="Target Relationship"><td><b>Neutral</b></td><td>Civilians, wildlife: perceived, not threatening. Threat weight 0.3.</td></tr><tr id="v-target-relationship-friendly" data-search="Friendly" data-text="Target Relationship"><td><b>Friendly</b></td><td>An allied faction: never a threat.</td></tr><tr id="v-target-relationship-teammate" data-search="Teammate" data-text="Target Relationship"><td><b>Teammate</b></td><td>Its own side: never a threat.</td></tr><tr id="v-target-relationship-enemy" data-search="Enemy" data-text="Target Relationship"><td><b>Enemy</b></td><td>Hostile. Threat weight 1.</td></tr><tr id="v-target-relationship-high-value" data-search="High Value" data-text="Target Relationship"><td><b>High Value</b></td><td>A priority target: a VIP, an objective carrier. Threat weight 1.2.</td></tr><tr id="v-target-relationship-feared" data-search="Feared" data-text="Target Relationship"><td><b>Feared</b></td><td>Something to run from. Threat weight 1.5, the most.</td></tr></tbody></table></div>

### Threat Level
<div class="comp-doc"><p>How dangerous the AI thinks a target is, from its threat score and the profile&#x27;s thresholds.</p></div>
<div class="table"><table class="enum"><thead><tr><th>Value</th><th>Meaning</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr id="v-threat-level-none" data-search="None" data-text="Threat Level"><td><b>None</b></td><td>No threat (also always for Friendly, Teammate and Expired targets).</td></tr><tr id="v-threat-level-low" data-search="Low" data-text="Threat Level"><td><b>Low</b></td><td>Score at Threat Threshold Low or above.</td></tr><tr id="v-threat-level-medium" data-search="Medium" data-text="Threat Level"><td><b>Medium</b></td><td>Score at Threat Threshold Medium or above.</td></tr><tr id="v-threat-level-high" data-search="High" data-text="Threat Level"><td><b>High</b></td><td>Score at Threat Threshold High or above.</td></tr><tr id="v-threat-level-critical" data-search="Critical" data-text="Threat Level"><td><b>Critical</b></td><td>Score at Threat Threshold Critical or above.</td></tr></tbody></table></div>

## Structs
### APSChannel Spec
<div class="comp-doc"><p>What a channel costs the information passing through it.</p></div>
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="f-apschannel-spec-delay" data-search="Delay" data-text="Seconds before the faction knows. The window in which stopping the messenger still changes the outcome."><div class="set-head"><b>Delay</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span><span>at least 0</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Seconds before the faction knows. The window in which stopping the messenger still changes the outcome.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="f-apschannel-spec-position-error" data-search="Position Error" data-text="Random position error added, in cm. A shouted location is approximate."><div class="set-head"><b>Position Error</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span><span>at least 0</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Random position error added, in cm. A shouted location is approximate.</p></div></div><div class="set" id="f-apschannel-spec-trait-loss-chance" data-search="Trait Loss Chance" data-text="Chance per trait that a detail is lost in the retelling [0..1]. Weighted by observability, so the obvious things survive and the subtle ones do not."><div class="set-head"><b>Trait Loss Chance</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span><span>0 to 1</span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Chance per trait that a detail is lost in the retelling (0 to 1). Second-hand is less certain.</p></div></div></div>

### APSDescriptor
<div class="comp-doc"><p>A set of traits: what someone really is (an APS Signature), or what a witness made out. The same type serves both, so one can be matched against the other.</p></div>
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="f-apsdescriptor-traits" data-search="Traits" data-text="The traits that make up the description: each a key (such as Coat), a value (such as Red) and how easy it is to notice."><div class="set-head"><b>Traits</b><span class="pin struct container"><i></i><small>Array of APSTrait</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"></div><div class="set-doc"><p>The traits that make up the description: each a key (such as Coat), a value (such as Red) and how easy it is to notice.</p></div></div></div>

### APSEvidence
<div class="comp-doc"><p>One piece of scripted evidence about a target (Add Target Evidence): what it does to belief, by how much, and for how long.</p></div>
<div class="set-list"><div class="set" id="f-apsevidence-tag" data-search="Tag" data-text="Identity of this evidence. Managed by APS."><div class="set-head"><b>Age</b><span class="pin float"><i></i><small>Float</small></span></div><div class="set-facts"><span>Default <b>0</b></span></div><div class="set-doc"><p>Seconds this entry has been held. ## Console commands
Type these in the console ([[`]] while playing, or the editor's **Cmd** box).

### aps.Visualizer
What the APS Visualizer shows. 0: nothing. 1 (default): everything. 2: status only (each AI's state over its head). (default `1`)

### aps.VisualizerPage
The page the APS Visualizer's screen panel shows (0 Senses, 1 Memory, 2 Brain, 3 Squad, 4 Events, 5 Player Model, 6 Environment). (default `0`)

### aps.UseSpatialIndex
1 (default): find perception candidates through the APS subsystem's spatial index. 0: fall back to scanning every Pawn in the world, once per agent, per gather. (default `1`)

### aps.Tune
aps.Tune <PropertyName> <Value> — set a profile value on every running agent, without touching the asset. Try: aps.Tune VisionMaxRange 5000
